description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Yale University is hiring a Research Software Engineer–Program Analyst for the Yale Digital Health Lab. The role develops, maintains, and supports secure web applications for healthcare, public-service, and research settings, while collaborating with researchers and stakeholders and helping ensure reliable deployment and protection of sensitive data.
Research software engineer developing and supporting healthcare and public-service web applications

Responsibilities:
• Support and enhance web applications used in healthcare and public-service settings
• Develop, test, document, and maintain application features using C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Explore the use of AI-assisted technologies to improve user experience, workflow automation, and digital health applications
• Investigate reported issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions
• Support users and research partners by responding to technical questions and software incidents
• Write and maintain SQL queries and support application databases
• Assist with application releases, configuration, deployment, and monitoring
• Participate in code reviews, testing, technical planning, and documentation
• Collaborate with researchers and stakeholders to translate operational needs into practical software solutions
• Help protect sensitive information by following appropriate security, privacy, and data-handling practices
• Contribute to additional digital health applications as project needs evolve
• Contributes in the development of programs or systems of small to moderate size and complexity
• Provides informational input into decisions concerning the development and delivery of applications, programs, and systems. Clarifies requirements to meet the expectations of stakeholders and intended end users needs, scheduled timeline, and budgetary targets
• Contributes to the collaborative effort of the analysis and design of new systems and applications. Performs various coding, debugging and unit testing tasks in support of applications, programs, and systems
• Contributes to the project definition, and the gathering of the functional requirements
• Troubleshoots problems whether due to data or software and rapidly resolves any problems that do occur. Provides ongoing maintenance and support for applications and systems
• Prepares documentation and user manuals. Provides support for training of end users
• Applies and keeps current with existing and emerging technologies and methodologies. Provides ongoing input to the establishment of programming standards, procedures, and methodologies
• May perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Foundational experience developing web applications
• Experience with at least one modern programming language, preferably C#
• Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and relational databases
• Understanding of software-development fundamentals, including debugging, testing, version control, and maintainable code
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills
• Ability to manage assignments reliably, ask questions when needed, and collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team
• Interest in developing technology for healthcare, research, or public-service applications
• Bachelor's Degree
• One year programming experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred:
• Experience with C#, ASP.NET or ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft SQL Server
• Experience supporting or maintaining a production web application
• Experience developing mobile or responsive web applications
• Familiarity with REST APIs, Git, automated testing, or continuous integration
• Familiarity with Docker, AWS, Azure, or another deployment environment
• Experience working with sensitive healthcare, research, or government data
• Familiarity with accessibility, usability, or human-computer interaction principles
• Familiarity with R or research-data workflows
